artifact.scope_note: Part V suspicious activity narrative for FinCEN SAR filing review.

claims.statement: Between 2026-05-10 and 2026-05-12, Apex Precision Logistics received an inbound wire of 94,000 USD followed by an outbound wire of 92,500 USD within 4 hours.

confidence.basis: Read directly from authenticated bank transfer records.

claims.statement: The rapid pass-through velocity reflects 98.4% liquidation with no apparent commercial dwell time.

confidence.basis: Ratio of credit to immediate onward debit.

claims.statement: Rapid movement of funds without clear trade documentation matches fast pass-through indicator.
The transactions reflect intermediary transit laundering through shell trade structures.
claims.falsifier: Audited commercial contracts and authenticated customs bills of lading justifying pass-through fee.

confidence.basis: Absence of underlying cargo clearance documentation on file.

claims.statement: The transactions represent bona fide urgent escrow agent pass-through for simultaneous freight charter settlements.
claims.falsifier: Confirmation from counterparties that funds were unrelated to charter freight.

confidence.basis: Commercial possibility requiring subpoena or law enforcement verification.

claims.statement: The account activity warrants consideration for formal FinCEN SAR filing under 31 CFR 1020.320 due to unexplained cross-border value transit.

confidence.basis: Aggregated indicator alignment under SAR filing regulations.

claims.statement: Submit Part V SAR narrative draft to the BSA Officer for formal review and recommend account restriction.

Immediate outbound pass-through wire of 92,500 USD to secondary trading firm

Corporate CDD extract confirming shared corporate address with three trading intermediaries

human_decision_required.question: Authorize electronic submission of SAR narrative to FinCEN and determine customer account closure.
